description: Building software with agents, end to end traceable: a requirement handed to a builder, the change reviewed, merged, released, migrated or applied. Platform-agnostic: repositories, trackers and hosts are named by reference (gh:, gl:, jira:, linear:, pensive:), never assumed. Every irreversible act (merge or push to a protected branch, deploy, migration, infrastructure apply, package publish) asks rb=exec, and the RB and the DN carry the execution slots listed under exec. The human's answers are closed.

sig.AGENT: a signal the system raised from its own records

asks.MERGE: merge the named branch at the named commit into the named base
asks.PUSH: push the named commit to the named branch
asks.DEPLOY: deploy the named version to the named environment
asks.ROLLBACK: return the environment to the previous version
asks.MIGRATE: run the named database migration; irreversible unless a down migration is named
asks.APPLY: apply the named infrastructure plan to the named environment; the plan is identified by its digest
asks.PUBLISH: publish the named version of a package or release from the named commit

slots.desc: repository by reference, e.g. gh:owner/name or gl:group/name
branch the change is on, or is pushed to
commit, full or at least 12 hex characters
digest of the infrastructure plan file, sha256:<hex>
the requirement the work traces to, e.g. pensive:5029 or jira:ABC-12
the principal's approval reference for an irreversible act
kind of signal a status line reports

translation.note: Every HO for build work names the requirement with req= and asks rb=acc or rb=plan; scope and test rules travel as acc constraints (scope:<path>, must:<rule>, no:<rule>, e.g. no:test-edit). Before an irreversible act the HO is built from the approval record by code or checked against it before it is sent (check-ho), asks rb=exec, and the RB and the DN carry the execution slots listed under exec, the DN with the values the tool printed. A commit made under a read-back HO carries the trailer RW-Trace: <session>/<HO id>.
